purpose.zh: 练手撑平衡和肩膀往前顶的力量
purpose.en: Build hand balance and the shoulder strength to lean forward over your hands.

text.zh: 肩膀往前送过手，双脚离地
text.en: Lean your shoulders past your hands and lift your feet

text.zh: 蹲着双手撑地，手指稍微朝外，手臂伸直。
text.en: Crouch with your hands flat, fingers turned slightly out, arms straight.

text.zh: 膝盖收在胸口下面，背微微拱起，稳住平衡。
text.en: Tuck your knees under your chest, round your back a little and hold the balance.

commonErrors.en: Lifting your feet before leaning forward.

cautions.zh: 手腕不舒服时先活动一下手腕
cautions.en: If your wrists feel stiff, warm them up first.

cautions.zh: 手腕或肩膀疼时缩短时间，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your wrists or shoulders hurt, hold for less time, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: 主口令原来塞了 4 个指令，缩成一件事：肩膀往前送过手、双脚离地；锁臂/拱背挪到 cues
training=hold（动画全程离地静止定住 8 s）
